verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a SaaS incorporation service with a user dashboard, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack never mentions an in-product AI assistant or any task delegation to one. The llms.txt probe only shows docs made available for external LLMs to read, which is an adjacent feature and not a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
